prospective_lifecycle.why_unresolved: The first two late bars preceded the target crossing and could have contained an earlier opposite-signal exit. Reconstructing them after recovery would introduce hindsight.

change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: The price path crossed the configured short target, but observer downtime made the pre-target opposite-exit path unknowable.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Fresh five-minute BRENTOIL oil shocks under the frozen q95 onset, 30-bps stop, 40-bps target, opposite-signal exit, and 60-minute fallback.
Alternatives considered: Count the target crossing as a win: rejected because it would use hindsight across missing decision bars.
Reconstruct late candles and infer the exit path: rejected because recovery-time data cannot prove what the prospective observer knew.
Lower entry thresholds: rejected because development stress already fails and post-event tuning would change the hypothesis.
Disable passive capture: deferred because a clean future lifecycle can still improve the observability diagnosis without capital exposure.
